subject: Week-of Nov 29: Harbor AI onsite — Harborroom booking, travel windows & clearance

Subject: Harbor AI — planning week-of Nov 29 onsite

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We're aiming to run an onsite at Redwood the week of Nov 29 (primary day Wed/Thu) to do:
- 90-min product walkthrough for execs + 3x breakout sessions (LLM cost/ops, security/QoS, integration patterns)
- 2-hour technical deep-dive with infra and ML infra teams

A few asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm a conference room that seats ~20 (with breakout side-rooms) and AV for dual-stream HDMI + room mics?
2) Is there a simple NDA/process we should complete ahead of the visit?
3) Parking/visitor logistics — do guests need to pre-register?

Attendee list for now: Erin Chen (PM, Harbor AI), Liam O'Neill (Eng Manager), Priya Singh (SRE) — might add one more. We'll send final headcount by next Tue.

If Nov 30 or Dec 1 works better for Redwood, let us know; we can be flexible by one or two days.

Best,
Erin Chen
Director of Partnerships
Harbor AI
(650) 555-0183

Hi Erin — great to hear, happy to host. High-level notes and next steps below.

Summary/what we'll hold for you:
- Primary room: Harborroom C (Exec floor) — seats 24 theater, breakout rooms A/B adjacent for concurrent sessions. AV: dual HDMI, room mic, Polycom for remote dial-in.
- Tentative dates: Wed Nov 30 (full day) + Thu Dec 1 (half-day deep dive) — hold on our calendar until we get final headcount.
- Security & clearance: please have guests complete the visitor badge form (I can send). For any laptop-only attendees that need network access, security will issue temporary guest creds.
- NDA: we use DocuSign for quick NDAs. I'll circulate the DocuSign link once we confirm attendee list.
- Parking: we can reserve 4 visitor spaces near Building 2; if you need more, let us know names/plates to pre-approve.

I've attached a very short preliminary agenda (redwood_prelim_agenda_v1.pdf) so you can comment on flow.

Action items:
- Erin: confirm final headcount + any dietary restrictions by Tue (11/17).
- Harbor AI: share final attendee names for badging and license plates for parking.
- Karthik: can you confirm AV inventory and if we need any extra laptops/dongles?
- Lauren: will coordinate hotel block options and catering.

I'll follow up with the DocuSign link and visitor badge form.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Monica Patel
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Monica — quick AV/tech checklist from my side (adding here so Erin sees):
- Harborroom C has a Crestron controller, two HDMI inputs and one USB-C. We'll bring two USB-C-to-HDMI adapters and a spare HDMI cable.
- We'll reserve a local presenter laptop (Windows 11) with VPN and internal test account if Harbor wants to demo on your infrastructure.
- For the 2-hour deep dive, please confirm if Harbor will need access to our isolated staging cluster (we can gate by IP and time window). If yes, we need a brief security list (IPs/usernames) before Nov 26.
- Network: guest Wi-Fi is available; for high-throughput model runs we'll provide a dedicated wired drop.

If Harbor plans a live inference run (even small scale), recommend we set aside 30–45 minutes for warm-up traffic and a short smoke test.

Karthik
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

- Catering: plated lunch for Wed (boxed lunches as fallback). Erin — can you confirm vegetarian/vegan/gluten-free counts by Tue 11/24?
- Parking & badges: I created the visitor_badge_form.xlsx — please have attendees fill it and return to security@redwood.com by Fri 11/26 for pre-approval.

- DocuSign NDA: Monica — please send Harbor the link; I will pull signed PDFs into the visit folder.

I'll also book a small refreshments station in Harborroom C for breaks.
